title: hey jochi
description: “A fun resource pack that changes the Totem of Undying pop sound to ‘hey jochi’.”
body:
Initial release of the resource pack

Replaced the Totem of Undying pop sound with "hey jochi"
Added a clean and recognizable custom audio effect
Balanced the volume to fit naturally with Minecraft sounds
Works in all situations where the Totem activates
Lightweight and simple, no performance impact
